# add_clustering_to_rag { #mofography.compute.add_clustering_to_rag }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-legacy">legacy</span> Older CSD-based clustering; env_cluster typing is more accurate. Use `add_env_cluster_pocket_types_to_rag` instead.

```python
compute.add_clustering_to_rag(
    rag2,
    return_cluster_obj=False,
    no_pbc=False,
    **kwargs,
)
```

Agglomeratively cluster RAG node feature vectors and write cluster labels on nodes.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name               | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Default    |
|--------------------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| rag2               |        | The `rag2` parameter in the `add_clustering_to_rag` function is expected to be a NetworkX graph object representing a region adjacency graph (RAG) with nodes and attributes. This graph is used to perform clustering on the data associated with the nodes in the graph       | _required_ |
| return_cluster_obj |        | The `return_cluster_obj` parameter in the `add_clustering_to_rag` function determines whether the function should return the clustering object along with the modified graph (`rag2`) or just the modified graph itself, defaults to False (optional)                           | `False`    |
| no_pbc             |        | The `no_pbc` parameter in the `add_clustering_to_rag` function is a boolean flag that specifies whether to use data without periodic boundary conditions (PBC). If `no_pbc` is set to `True`, the function will use data without PBC, while if it, defaults to False (optional) | `False`    |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
|--------|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | If `return_cluster_obj` is set to `True`, the function will return a tuple containing the updated RAG (`rag2`) and the clustering object (`clustering`). If `return_cluster_obj` is set to `False`, the function will return just the updated RAG (`rag2`). |
